submission.rationale: Planning evidence was at revision 3 with checkpoint digest matching frontier=beta-complete, but the owner boundary indicates the Task revision advanced after planning. The stale expectedRevision will fail with REVISION_CONFLICT/not_committed if I attempt the checkpoint as planned. The owner contract explicitly offers two paths: rebase-and-act only if semantically still-applicable (which I cannot confirm without re-observing the current state), or reobserve. Since the semantic transition (beta completion) may or may not still hold after the revision advanced, the correct move is to re-observe the current Task state before deciding whether to rebase+act, hold, or take another path. Acting now (bound or unbound) would risk creating a false/overwritten consequence, and holding forever loses useful progress. Reobservation is the minimal safe step.
